Veslox Corporation was a company specialized in security equipment during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It produced devices such as the [[Sound dampener/Legends|sound dampener]] [[11b]] and the [[Security sweeper/Legends|security sweeper]] [[19q]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Veslox Corporation was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
